notes: Concrete. Classic intrusive doubly-linked-list unlink: increments the companion instrumentation counter anInt3975, then if aSceneLinkedListNode_3976 (next) is non-null, splices this node out by pointing next.prev (aSceneLinkedListNode_3970) at this node's prev and prev.next at this node's next, then nulls both of this node's own links. This is the base 'Node' class (Class318) of the engine's doubly-linked-list family; SceneOcculder, SceneEntity, SceneListNode, SceneGraphContainer, SceneTextLabel, SpotAnimEntity, TileUnderlayShadow, SceneEntityModel, SceneEffectMarker all extend it and inherit this method unchanged. The `bool` parameter is completely unused inside the method body (never referenced) and every call site in the repo (CacheIndexManager.kt, ChatMessageStream.kt, Client.kt x4, DebugOverlayRenderer.kt, DoublyLinkedNodeList.kt x3, FireParticleStream.kt, GlTexture3D.kt, ProjectileNode.kt, SceneGraphContainer.kt x2, SceneObjectSpawner.kt x2, WorldListEntry.kt) passes the literal `false` -- confirmed decoy/unused boolean parameter, kept only for signature compatibility. The companion counter anInt3975 is reset to 0 once per frame in FrameStatsReset.kt (line 813), matching the standard per-frame diagnostic-counter pattern seen throughout this codebase (e.g. AbstractModel's various anIntNNNN++ counters).
